about_the_game:
Blackthorne’s Manor is a first-person puzzle-horror experience that plunges you into the unsettling depths of a long-abandoned estate.

Your friend vanished after attending a party at the manor, and no one has seen them since. Armed with little more than your wits and a faintly glowing lantern, you step inside, not knowing what you'll find on the other side. Shadowed rooms, cryptic puzzles, and fragments of a dark history wait around every corner. The manor’s decaying halls and strange, unsettling details hint at the sinister events that took place here. Can you uncover the secrets of Blackthorne’s Manor, or will its mysteries remain locked forever?

RISING TENSION
Immerse yourself in the oppressive atmosphere of the manor, where every shadowed hallway and forgotten room hides a story. Interact with objects, solve environmental puzzles, and piece together the chilling history of Blackthorne’s family. Every discovery draws you deeper into the mystery, blending suspense and intrigue in a slow-burn horror experience.

ESCAPING THE UNKNOWN
Move through a semi-linear environment designed like a twisted escape room. Unlock doors, trigger mechanisms, and follow hidden clues to advance. Every puzzle solved reveals more of the manor’s story and brings you closer to finding your missing friend.

FEATURES

  • First-person exploration with environmental puzzle-solving.

  • Creepy, atmospheric manor with a story woven into every room.

  • Inventory-based interactions to manipulate the world and unlock new rooms.

  • Lore fragments and hidden notes that reveal the manor’s dark past.

  • Slow-burn suspense that escalates as you uncover the truth.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7 8750H
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Laptop
  • Storage: 5000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: The game could run on slightly lower hardware, this is the lowest tested specs for around 30fps
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600 or Intel Core i5 10th gen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060
  • Storage: 5000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Around 60fps

short_description: Blackthorne's Manor is a first-person mystery thriller, where logic, puzzles, and the supernatural collide. Search for your missing friend, uncover the secrets of Blackthorne Manor, and escape before the house claims you too.
